text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Cream and navy broad striped V-neck sweater vest with tiny red chest embroidery over pale blue fine-striped collared shirt with rolled sleeves, dark brown tailored shorts, cream calf socks and brown leather loafers.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black thick acetate rectangular eyeglasses with clear transparent optical lenses, full frame and both temples visible.; One classic silver metal bracelet wristwatch with simple light dial, shown alone.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product photo to remove unwanted additions. Remove the entire navy scarf and belt. Keep only the striped sweater vest over blue shirt, brown shorts, cream socks, brown loafers, clear optical glasses and ONE silver watch. Preserve all other cuts, colors, proportions and fabric detail. Empty hollow clothes, no skin or mannequin, white seamless background, full outfit uncropped. Do not add anything.
